theorems.name: Submission.gaussGreenRep_normal_ae_eq_of_pairing
theorems.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (U : Set (Rn N)) (μ : Measure (Rn N)) (ν ν' : Rn N → Rn N), IsOpen U → μ Uᶜ = 0 → (∀ K : Set (Rn N), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μ K < ∞) → AEStronglyMeasurable ν μ → AEStronglyMeasurable ν' μ → (∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ‖ν x‖ ≤ 1) → (∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ‖ν' x‖ ≤ 1) → (∀ g : Rn N → Rn N, Continuous g → HasCompactSupport g → tsupport g ⊆ U → ∫ x, inner ℝ (g x) (ν x) ∂μ = ∫ x, inner ℝ (g x) (ν' x) ∂μ) → ν =ᵐ[μ] ν'
